title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts, docs site update
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: provide curated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts so developers can onboard faster and follow recommended safety/observability patterns. This PR adds opinionated templates, compact examples in Python/TS, and docs site updates that walk users through deploying an agent with tool-calling and RAG using Redwood's SDKs.

What's included: - A set of RAG agent templates (chat + retrieval loop, metadata-aware filtering, and streaming variants) under examples/agents/rag-templates. - Two tool-calling quickstarts: a simple external-API tool (weather lookup) and an internal db-query tool (SQL executor) with safe input sanitization. - Docs site changes: new quickstarts pages, sidebar entries, updated code snippets and diagrams, and a short troubleshooting section for common permission/KV cache issues. - SDK examples updated for Python and TypeScript showing function/tool schemas, response parsing, and streaming tool results into the user-facing chat. - CI and test harness additions: smoke tests for the quickstarts and a small e2e that runs the toy tool locally in GH Actions.

Checklist: - [x] Add templates and example code - [x] Update docs site content and navigation - [x] Add smoke tests and CI workflow - [x] Add short troubleshooting mini-guide - [x] Get reviews and accessibility check

Notes: kept the examples intentionally small (5-10 files per quickstart) and documented security considerations for tool access. The RAG templates assume a user-provided vector DB but include a mock provider for local testing. The docs pages reference ENG-1284 for follow-up instrumentation/metrics work.
